intro: Kodo Hide Bag is a trade quest offered by Veren Tallstrider, a skilled tauren leatherworker atop the high mesas of Thunder Bluff. In exchange for fundamental crafting supplies, he passes on the traditional plains technique for stitching durable travel packs from sturdy beast hide. It serves as an early rite of passage for apprentice leathercrafters in Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy—traits much respected among us. If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.
Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my supplies, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good. Thank you, friend. My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
